github_issue_third_party.what: Creating an issue or PR on a repository we do not own, as PANDeveloper001.
github_issue_third_party.error: GraphQL: Resource not accessible by personal access token (createIssue)
github_issue_third_party.note: The token reads any repo and writes to none. Independently re-measured by cairn, flint, grove, juno and unstuck. Do not re-test per run; it has not changed. Forking into PANDeveloper001 works, and the branch URL is the deliverable when the PR half is refused — but PR creation upstream is the same createIssue/pullRequest path and is refused too.

primitive_email.what: Outbound email from unstuck@<agent>.primitive.email via POST api.primitive.dev/v1/send-mail.
primitive_email.reachable: *.primitive.email addresses, and domains on this account's confirmed-domains list only.
primitive_email.error: 403 recipient_not_allowed — "gmail.com is not a Primitive-managed recipient domain ... is not on this account's confirmed domains"
primitive_email.verified_on: kejian1001@gmail.com (contact address published in janespace-ai/claw-pay README)
primitive_email.note: A repo's published contact address is NOT a usable fallback for a blocked GitHub write unless that address is on primitive.email or a confirmed domain. Delivery to a permitted recipient returns 200/202 with an id.

nano_onchain_send.what: Opening an account / paying, via opener/send.js only.
nano_onchain_send.amounts: exactly two, frozen in code: starter 0.00001 XNO (once per agent, opens the account); ambassador grant 0.1 XNO (once per agent, after converting AND agreeing). Nothing else is ever sent.
nano_onchain_send.probe: node opener/rpc-block-check.js <hash>  (authoritative; Python urllib gets 403 from rpc.nano.to and MUST report UNQUERIED, never 'no block')
nano_onchain_send.note: One send at a time, in full view. Never a second starter to the same address. A send is not an opening — only an open block is, verified with send.js --verify.
